description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for managing progressive, batched processing of a list of items, typically used in expanding tree nodes or other UI updates that should not block the main thread. It provides an interface for starting, canceling, and monitoring progress of these batched operations, leveraging requestIdleCallback when available.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages the progressive batch processing of items, allowing start and cancel operations, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, managing UI state such as running status, progress percentage, and counts, and providing methods to start processing from an array of items and cancel ongoing processing.
